text: Chengdu Rongjiu Liquor Co., Ltd. (成都蓉酒酒业有限公司), the company behind the 萬世珍水 (Wanshi Zhenshui) brand, was established with 500 million yuan registered capital and is held 51% by Chengdu Industrial Investment Group Co., Ltd., its controlling shareholder.
short: Chengdu Industrial Investment Group holds a controlling 51% of Chengdu Rongjiu Liquor.

source.name: 川观新闻·川商传媒 (Cover News / Sichuan Daily's Chuanshang Media): 斥资5亿元！成都五大国企联手，布局这一赛道→
source.quote: 成都产业投资集团有限公司认缴出资额2.55亿元，持股51%
source.note: Translation: 'Chengdu Industrial Investment Group Co., Ltd. subscribed 255 million yuan, holding 51%.' The article lists all five state-owned shareholders from equity-penetration data (Qichacha).

additionalSources.name: 钛媒体 via 新浪财经 (TMTPost via Sina Finance): 成都5亿元国资合资企业落地，国资产区平台成白酒第三极，与巨头共舞？
additionalSources.quote: 成都产业投资集团有限公司持股51%、成都酒业集团有限公司持股34%
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Chengdu Industrial Investment Group Co., Ltd. holds 51% and Chengdu Liquor Group Co., Ltd. 34%.' Lists the same five state-owned shareholders; the article also states Chengdu Industrial Investment Group holds 51% as controlling shareholder (控股股东).

additionalSources.name: 网易号·懂球帝 (NetEase Hao, Dongqiudi, reprint of the club's announcement): 官方：蓉酒酒业成为成都蓉城战略合作伙伴，获得球衣胸前广告
additionalSources.quote: 作为成都产投集团旗下国资酒企
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'As a state-owned liquor company under Chengdu Industrial Investment Group.' The club's own announcement describing the sponsor's ownership (also on Dongqiudi, m.dongqiudi.com/article/5855106.html).
